overview: Back at Great St Helen's you set down the twenty-pound Whitehall warrant figures, Heminges's deferral of Burbage's peach-coloured velvet until autumn, and your own thirty-seven shillings and sixpence laid by in the chest toward a hired horse for Warwickshire in Lent.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Recorded the warrant split at Great St Helen's and laid his share in the chest.

parties.name: John Heminges
parties.context: Cast the sheet at Holywell and put off the peach velvet till autumn.

parties.name: Richard Burbage
parties.context: Asked for seven yards of peach-coloured velvet in grain for a king.

parties.name: Edith Kettlewood
parties.context: Eight shillings set aside out of the stock part for Thursday.

assets.name: Greenwich Chamber warrant
assets.disposition: Wrote down the Whitehall share and horse money

summary: Wrote down the Whitehall share and horse money
